name: MERSI Architecture
title: Shared image, new context.
description: One original image moves from its card into a project dialog, preserving continuity across the layout change.
scope: The original author documents GSAP Flip and Taxi.js. This component independently implements the geometric principle with Web Animations. It is a single-page transition, not a routed copy.

name: Obys Agency
title: Typography takes the lead.
description: Staggered text enters through clipped lines. Switch the composition without losing the same content.
scope: Selected typographic techniques are independently rebuilt. The exact Obys production timeline and pointer shader are not reproduced.

name: GT Flexa
title: A living type specimen.
description: Explore width and weight as continuous controls, and edit the specimen directly.
tech: Font axes / geometric fallback / editable text
scope: Commercial GT Flexa files are not bundled. Supply a licensed variable font for native axes. The width control also uses a geometric fallback, explicitly distinct from real glyph interpolation.

name: NIPPON COLORS
title: Color becomes the interface.
description: Background, title, hexadecimal value and selection state change together.
tech: Theme state / contrast-aware labels / CSS interpolation
scope: The demo palette and layout are original. The selected technique is synchronized color presentation, not a copy of the original palette database.

name: Stripe Press
title: A book with a little depth.
description: Move over the cover or adjust its rotation to explore a dimensional object built from lightweight planes.
tech: CSS perspective / pointer mapping / keyboard range
scope: This is a CSS 3D book, not a recovered Stripe model or renderer. Cover artwork and text are original.

name: The Boat
title: A story carried by layers.
description: Ink-like marks, terrain layers and typography share one narrative progress value.
scope: The original page was captured at its opening state. This is a technique study with procedural illustration, without SBS artwork, story text or sound.

name: Short Trip
title: A small journey through paper.
description: Move a tram through a layered drawn landscape. Velocity and scenery update from the same elapsed time.
scope: Original procedural scenery and a simplified vehicle are supplied. This does not reconstruct Short Trip's artwork, route, characters or game engine.

name: Igloo Inc.
title: One cloud, two identities.
description: Thousands of GPU points interpolate between a sphere and a torus while the view responds to the pointer.
scope: The first original capture was incomplete and showed a sparse loading state. The particle technique is an independent study; the exact Igloo shader is unverified.

name: Bruno Simon
title: Drive the interface.
description: A small vehicle moves through an original projected world with obstacle resolution and a damped following camera.
scope: This is a deliberately small CPU-projected 3D prototype. Bruno's current production project uses Three.js with WebGL/WebGPU and Rapier, confirmed by its own technical page. This does not reproduce that renderer or physics engine.

name: Patatap
title: Every key leaves a shape.
description: Keyboard notes create visual gestures; sound starts only after an explicit audio action.
scope: Original synthesized tones replace the original samples. The source site credits Two.js; this independent study uses Canvas and Web Audio.

name: Human Terrain
title: Values become a skyline.
description: A linear value-to-height function creates a field of columns, with continuous scenario blending and camera rotation.
scope: The included field is synthetic and does not estimate real population. The mount API accepts real grids. Production GHSL processing, vector tiles and Mapbox camera behavior remain separate from this small component.

name: Earth Nullschool
title: A field you can follow.
description: Particles advect over an orthographic globe. Drag the view and change speed or the illustrative scientific layer.
scope: The field is synthetic. It is not live weather, and the illustrative temperature layer has no measured units. Real data ingestion, temporal interpolation and scientific legends are not implemented.

name: Land Lines
title: Draw a line. Find a relation.
description: Resampled strokes are normalized and compared against a small procedural atlas, independent of scale and drawing direction.
tech: Polyline resampling / normalized distance / pointer input
scope: The original project uses preprocessed satellite imagery, a vantage point tree and Pixi.js. This prototype uses original procedural shapes and exact search over three candidates, with no satellite image dataset.

name: Mechanical Watch
title: Reveal the mechanism.
description: Rotate an illustrated gear train and separate its layers with a continuous section control.
scope: This is an illustrative gear train, not a mechanically complete watch movement or a recovered original CAD model.

name: LOW←TECH MAGAZINE
title: Less color. More character.
description: Convert an original procedural image to two colors using ordered dithering or error diffusion, then export the result.
scope: No third-party image is bundled. The original publishing theme is Hugo and AGPL-3.0; this independently written image component does not incorporate its code.
